### Open Sets & Closed Sets on Metric Spaces

The concept of open and closed sets is important 

:::{.definition data-title="Open Sets & Closed Sets (Metric Spaces)"}

For
[[knowledge-mathematics-analysis-functional-analysis-metric-spaces|metric space]]
$(X,d)$ a subset $A\subseteq X$ is said to be **open** if for each $x\in A$
there exists an open [[epsilon-ball|epsilon ball]] such that
$B_\epsilon(x)\subseteq A$. A subset $A\subseteq X$ is said to be **closed** if
its complement $A^c$ is open.

:::
